story.text: 승객 여러분, 환영합니다! 오늘은 세계가 인정한 한글의 과학적 원리를 탐험해볼 거예요.
story.reading: seung-gaek yeo-reo-bun, hwan-yeong-ham-ni-da! o-neul-eun se-gye-ga in-jeong-han han-geul-ui gwa-hak-jeok won-ri-reul tam-heom-hae-bol geo-ye-yo.
story.en: Welcome, passengers! Today we'll explore the scientific principles behind Hangul, recognized by the world.

story.text: 이 모든 이야기는 '세종대왕'으로부터 시작돼요. 백성을 가장 사랑한 조선의 네 번째 왕이었죠.
story.en: This whole story starts with 'King Sejong' — the fourth king of Joseon who loved his people the most.

story.text: 세종대왕은 1443년, '훈민정음'이라는 새로운 문자를 만들었어요. '백성을 가르치는 바른 소리'라는 뜻이에요.
story.reading: se-jong-dae-wang-eun cheon-sa-baek-sa-si-bsam-nyeon, hun-min-jeong-eum-i-ra-neun sae-ro-un mun-ja-reul man-deu-reo-sseo-yo.
story.en: In 1443, King Sejong created a new writing system called 'Hunminjeongeum' — meaning 'the correct sounds to teach the people'.

story.text: 한글의 '자음'은 발음할 때 혀와 입의 모양을 그대로 본떠 만들었어요. 정말 과학적이지 않나요?
story.reading: han-geul-ui ja-eum-eun bal-eum-hal ttae hyeo-wa ib-ui mo-yang-eul geu-dae-ro bon-tteo man-deu-reo-sseo-yo.
story.en: Hangul's 'consonants' were shaped directly after the tongue and mouth positions used to pronounce them. Isn't that scientific?

story.text: '모음'은 하늘(ㆍ), 땅(ㅡ), 사람(ㅣ)을 본떠 만든 철학적인 글자예요.
story.reading: mo-eum-eun ha-neul, ttang, sa-ram-eul bon-tteo man-deun cheol-hak-jeog-in geul-ja-ye-yo.
story.en: The 'vowels' are philosophical characters modeled after heaven (ㆍ), earth (ㅡ), and people (ㅣ).

story.text: 이런 한글의 우수성을 기리기 위해, 매년 10월 9일을 '한글날'로 기념하고 있어요.
story.reading: i-reon han-geul-ui u-su-seong-eul gi-ri-gi wi-hae, mae-nyeon si-wol gu-il-eul han-geul-nal-lo gi-nyeom-ha-go it-seo-yo.
story.en: To honor Hangul's excellence, October 9th is celebrated every year as 'Hangul Day'.

story.text: 자, 오늘 배운 다섯 단어를 가지고 문제를 풀어볼까요? 세종대왕님도 응원하고 계실 거예요!
story.reading: ja, o-neul bae-un da-seot dan-eo-reul ga-ji-go mun-je-reul pul-eo-bol-kka-yo?
story.en: Now, shall we solve some questions with today's five words? King Sejong is cheering you on too!

words.example_en: King Sejong was the king who loved his people the most.
Hangul is made up of 14 consonants.

words.example: 모음은 하늘, 땅, 사람을 본떠 만들었어요.
words.example_reading: mo-eum-eun ha-neul, ttang, sa-ram-eul bon-tteo man-deu-reo-sseo-yo
words.example_en: The vowels were made based on the shapes of heaven, earth, and people.

sentences.en: King Sejong was the king who loved his people the most.
The consonants were modeled after the shapes of speech organs.
The vowels represent heaven, earth, and people.
On Hangul Day, we celebrate the excellence of Hangul.
